header: Reductions that depend on who is asking
subheader: Four standing programmes. None of them has to be negotiated.
lead: Send the document named beside the programme to abrechnung@example.org and the reduction is applied from the next invoice. We do not ask for it back if circumstances change mid-year.
note: One reduction per practice; they are not stacked, and the largest one you qualify for is the one applied. Reductions apply to the plan price, not to metered items or one-off fees.

programmes.title: Newly founded practice — 25 % for 12 months
programmes.text: For practices whose trade licence is less than 24 months old. Proof: a copy of the Gewerbeschein or the date of your first fund contract.

programmes.title: Training practice — 15 %
programmes.text: For practices that take students on clinical placement for at least eight weeks a year. Proof: the placement agreement with the university of applied sciences.

programmes.title: Charitable provider — 20 %
programmes.text: For associations and foundations with a charitable ruling. Proof: the current Bescheid from the tax office.

programmes.title: Professional association member — 10 %
programmes.text: For members of a recognised professional body for physiotherapy, occupational therapy or speech therapy. Proof: your membership number.
